Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Travis Head and Matthew Short to open for the Aussies. Aiden Markram to bowl first. Let's go...
... The Run Chase ...

Australia did not begin all that well with the ball but Ellis, Sean and Jason were really good. They picked timely wickets and got their side ahead. The target is still a challenging one on a slow surface. Australia have batters in form. South Africa will have to bowl really well. Stay tuned for the chase.

South Africa have recovered well but Australia will be happier of the two sides. The start though was brilliant for the hosts courtesy Bavuma. Once he fell they lost a few wickets quickly. Markram and Stubbs then steadied the ship. Stubbs fell but Markram continued. When he was batting 175 looked possible. He fell with 9 balls to go but Ngidi has taken them to a competitive total.
On a length and on off, Ngidi slaps it to deep point for a brace. South Africa end their innings for 164/8.

Time for the National Anthems! Australia will be singing their first and then it will be the hosts' turn!

South Africa (PLAYING XI) - Reeza Hendricks, Temba Bavuma, Rassie van der Dussen, Aiden Markram (C), Dewald Brevis, Tristan Stubbs (WK), Bjorn Fortuin, Gerald Coetzee, Lungi Ngidi, Lizaad Williams, Tabraiz Shamsi.
Australia (PLAYING XI) - Travis Head, Matthew Short, Mitchell Marsh (C), Josh Inglis (WK), Marcus Stoinis, Tim David, Aaron Hardie, Sean Abbott, Nathan Ellis, Adam Zampa, Jason Behrendorff.
Aiden Markram says it is a new day and it is an opportunity for them to start fresh and do well in this game. Informs they have made a change.
Mitchell Marsh says it seems a fresh wicket and they want to make early use of it. Informs they have two changes. He hopes for another good performance and win the game.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and ELECTED TO BOWL!

It is currently drizzling at the moment but it seems to be clearing! For now, the covers are on and the TOSS HAS BEEN DELAYED! The drizzle is very light and we hope it is not a long delay. Well, just as we write that, the toss now takes place.

A real thrashing is what we witnessed in the first T20I. Marsh led from the front and the debutant Sangha had a game to remember. Australia would now look to continue the momentum and make it two in a row. South Africe on the other hand, will be hopeful of putting up a better performance this time. Let's hope we get an equal contest between bat and ball.
